findings.issue: Spec-critical pure helpers (humanize word-casing, last-English flavor text with \s+ collapse, dex padding, ÷10 measures, em-dash fallback) have no unit tests; a data-layer refactor would break them silently.
findings.suggestion: Add a node:test suite covering these five helpers with real edge cases (mr-mime, form-feed flavor text, null power, 0 height) — half a day, no new deps.

findings.issue: URL state handling (page NaN/0/out-of-range clamping, invalid type/generation silently treated as default, 48-per-page slice) is untested; off-by-one or clamp regressions surface as wrong/duplicated results.
findings.suggestion: Extract the param parsing/filter/slice into a testable function and test clamping plus each invalid-param case.

findings.issue: pokemonRefsToSpecies' alternate-form exclusion (<10000), dedupe-keeps-first-extra and dex sort back four routes; regressions cause duplicate cards, alternate-form links, or dropped hidden-ability notes.
findings.suggestion: Unit test with stubbed api() refs: one alternate form, two refs resolving to the same species with different extras.

findings.issue: Moves method ordering (rank + alphabetical), level-up sort (level then name) and default game via versionGroups.at(-1) are untested; the a.order - b.order comparator returns NaN when order is undefined.
findings.suggestion: Extract method-rank/table-sort into a pure function and test it; guard against undefined order in the comparator.

findings.issue: Client-side table sorting sorts by DOM cell text with column indices that shift depending on the Level column; easy to break, currently untested.
findings.suggestion: Playwright test: click Power on both a Level Up and a Machine table, assert first/last rows and aria-sort flip; assert '—' rows land last both directions.

findings.issue: Fetch-and-swap enhancement silently no-ops on non-200 responses (missing #results) while the URL has already changed, and popstate resync is untested.
findings.suggestion: Check res.ok before parsing and fall back to a full navigation; add a Playwright test for back/forward and a server-error case.

findings.issue: idFromUrl throws on malformed URLs and non-404 API errors propagate unhandled — a single odd datum 500s a whole page; no test pins the cache-eviction-on-failure behaviour either.
findings.suggestion: Unit test fetchJson's 404→null and error-evicts-cache paths; make idFromUrl return null (or throw a caught, per-entry error) so one bad ref doesn't kill the page.

findings.issue: No test script and no runner dependency, so CI has no app-level test step to grow into.
findings.suggestion: Add a `test` script (node:test needs no dependency) wired to vitest/playwright only if/when those suites appear.

findings.issue: STAT_LABELS keys fall back silently to humanize() on a typo, and the Total sum is untested.
findings.suggestion: Cover in the util-style unit suite: assert the six exact labels and a total for a stubbed stats array.

summary: The agent wrote no tests at all, despite having conveniently pure, easily testable helpers in util.js, data.js and api.js. Until the acceptance suite, everything — formatting rules, filter/pagination math, species mapping, moves ordering, client-side sorting — is unguarded against refactors. Risk is medium-term: the acceptance suite is strong, but it samples rendered output at fixed URLs and won't catch edge cases like invalid page params, malformed ids or silent no-op errors in the client enhancement.
